slides.headline: Moth StorySlam in Miramar, Oct. 20
slides.body: Tuesday at 7 p.m., the Miramar Cultural Center hosts five-minute stories on the theme “Magic.” Tickets are $17.

slides.headline: Tunnel of Terror in Miami, Oct. 21
slides.body: Wednesday from 5 to 9 p.m., El Car Wash at 6695 W. Flagler St. turns into a haunted tunnel with a live DJ and scare actors. Standard car wash pricing applies.

photo.query: car wash tunnel red lights night scare actors
photo.prompt: A red-lit car wash tunnel at night with fog, water spray, and Halloween scare actors near the entrance

slides.headline: South Beach Seafood Festival, Oct. 21 to 23
slides.body: The 14th annual festival runs Wednesday through Saturday at venues in Miami Beach, with more than 50 restaurants. Ticket prices vary by event.

photo.query: South Beach seafood festival crowd chefs serving food Miami Beach
photo.prompt: A crowded Miami Beach seafood festival at sunset with chefs serving plates under bright tents

slides.headline: Halloween Moonlight Masquerade, Oct. 22
slides.body: Thursday at 8 p.m., Sacred Space hosts live music, an open bar, local restaurant bites, and theatrical performances. Tickets are $125.

photo.query: masquerade party candlelight live performers garden venue night

slides.headline: Folklore & Foliage, Oct. 23
slides.body: Friday at 6 p.m., Miami Beach Botanical Garden brings dark art vendors, old Florida ghost lore, shadow puppets, vintage Halloween footage, and tarot readings. RSVP is free.
